tasks.text: In Sheets, create the campaign plan spreadsheet. On a sheet named "Headline tests" enter columns Headline, Visits, Signups, Conversion with these rows: "Small desk. Clear head." 240 18; "Light that stays out of the way." 240 12; "Your desk, finally calm." 240 9. Make Conversion a formula Signups/Visits formatted as a percentage, and add a row "Winner" naming "Small desk. Clear head." at 7.5%. These are synthetic planning figures.
In Notes, create a note titled "Launch headline" whose text is the winning headline from the campaign spreadsheet: Small desk. Clear head.

In the Word Processor, create the launch page: a new document whose first heading is "Small desk. Clear head." (documents are named by their first heading), right under it the line "Caption: The chalk-white desk light beside the campaign's deep-teal panel.", then a short introduction paragraph for the chalk-white desk light, a "Specifications" section, an "Availability" section and an "FAQ" section with three questions and answers, using only these facts: available October 22; $129; chalk-white finish; 14 cm base; three brightness levels. Check every product claim against those facts, keep the introduction tight, and end with a paragraph starting "Review:" listing what you checked.
In the Sheets spreadsheet "Campaign plan", add a sheet "Channel allocation" splitting a synthetic $4,000 launch budget across Email, Social, Partners and Search.
In the Sheets spreadsheet "Campaign plan", add a sheet "Email funnel" with Sent, Opened, Clicked and Signed up stages (synthetic figures).
In the Sheets spreadsheet "Campaign plan", add a sheet "Partner dates" with three fictional partners and dates in October.
In the Sheets spreadsheet "Campaign plan", add a sheet "Budget check" comparing planned and allocated spend against the $4,000 budget (synthetic figures).
In the Sheets spreadsheet "Campaign plan", add a sheet "Deliverables" tracking: campaign image, launch page, email, partner kit, each with an owner and status.
Export the Sheets spreadsheet "Campaign plan" with all its sheets as an Excel workbook, kept as content.
Export the note "Launch headline" as Markdown, kept as content.
